objective: Go home to Emberwood: Asahi is waiting in the yard at noon
title: Noon, Again
summary: What became of everyone, and the rematch Asahi has been promising since the first morning.

say: The hero of the Five Winds. The first-years have made a song about you. It's terrible.

lines: What did the academy decide about Kagerou?
I spoke for him. For two hours. I've never talked that long in my life.
He stays, under watch. He'll teach the fire classes. Control, not strength. He asked for that himself.
The Watch wanted him. The council told them the academy looks after its own. Even the ones it got wrong.
Back at the dam with Chiyo, scraping his own seals off the stone. He says it's the hardest work he's ever done.
Tsumugi left at dawn with the Watch. She said to tell you there's a place for you there, when you're tired of being loud.
She meant Asahi. Speaking of whom.

say: Noon. Exactly. I've been standing here since eleven.
No scroll, no thief, no spirit with five faces. Just you, me, and academy rules.
No real blades. No lasting harm. Stop when I say stop.
And this time I've been practising. Lightning first, then something you haven't seen.

phases.say: My mother's second nature. Wind! Didn't see that coming, did you?

lines: Wear something you don't mind getting singed.
Graduation was the easy part, {name}. Everything after it is yours.

beats.text: The End  ·  The islands are yours
